#!/bin/bash
# Installs the game's Windows prerequisites from 17020/PreReqs into the Wine
# prefix, once each, with the same switches Steam uses (17020/installscript.vdf):
# VC++ 2005, NVIDIA PhysX, .NET Framework 3.5 and DirectX (web setup).
# Each one leaves a marker in the prefix, so later updates skip it.
# Results go to amp-wine-prereqs.log next to this script.
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
BASE="$(pwd)"
export WINEPREFIX="$BASE/.wine" WINEDEBUG=-all
PRE="$BASE/17020/PreReqs"
LOG="$BASE/amp-wine-prereqs.log"

install() {   # install <marker> <installer> <switches...>
    local marker="$WINEPREFIX/.ga-prereq-$1"; shift
    if [ -f "$marker" ]; then echo "== skip $1 (already installed)" >> "$LOG"; return 0; fi
    if [ ! -f "$PRE/$1" ]; then echo "== skip $1 (not in PreReqs)" >> "$LOG"; return 0; fi
    echo "== $(date -u '+%F %T') $*" >> "$LOG"
    timeout 1800 /usr/bin/xvfb-run -a /usr/bin/wine "$PRE/$1" "${@:2}" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
    local rc=$?
    /usr/bin/wineserver -w
    echo "exit code $rc" >> "$LOG"
    # 0 = success, 3010 % 256 = 194 = success but wants a reboot.
    if [ $rc -eq 0 ] || [ $rc -eq 194 ]; then touch "$marker"; fi
}

install vcredist   vcredist.exe   /Q
install physx      physx.exe      /passive /norestart
install dotnet35   dotnetfx35.exe /qb
install directx    dxwebsetup.exe /Q

if ls "$WINEPREFIX"/drive_c/windows/syswow64/PhysXLoader.dll "$WINEPREFIX"/drive_c/windows/system32/PhysXLoader.dll 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
    echo "check: PhysXLoader.dll present" >> "$LOG"
else
    echo "check: PhysXLoader.dll MISSING" >> "$LOG"
fi
exit 0

UpdateStageName: Install Game Prerequisites into Wine (PreReqs folder)

#!/bin/bash
# Writes a starter control-server.json on first install only.
# Updates never overwrite an existing control-server.json, so edit it freely.
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
mkdir -p logs crashes
[ -f control-server.json ] && exit 0
BASE="$(pwd)"
tok() { head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'; }
cat > control-server.json <<EOF
{
    "wine_binary": "/usr/bin/wine",
    "wine_prefix": "${BASE}/.wine",
    "xvfb_run_path": "/usr/bin/xvfb-run",
    "game_binary": "${BASE}/17020/Binaries/GlobalAgenda.exe",
    "host": "127.0.0.1",
    "nat_networks": "",
    "nat_ip": "",
    "home_map_name": "Dome3_VR_Arena_P",
    "home_map_game_mode": "TgGame.TgGame_Mission",
    "tcp_port": 9000,
    "chat_port": 9001,
    "ipc_port": 9010,
    "udp_port_range": { "lo": 9002, "hi": 9020 },
    "admin_token": "$(tok)",
    "overlay_http_port": 0,
    "overlay_token": "$(tok)",
    "startup_timeout_seconds": 300,
    "db_path": "${BASE}/server.db",
    "crash_dir": "Z:${BASE}/crashes",
    "log_dir": "Z:${BASE}/logs",
    "fix_package_guids": false,
    "clear_logs": true,
    "use_docker": false,
    "per_slot_prefix": false,
    "enabled_channels": [],
    "enabled_crash_channels": [],
    "announcers": []
}
EOF
chmod 600 control-server.json
